newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Nextel buy reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Nextel buy reiterated.

text.p: -- NatWest Securities said it reiterated its buy rating on Nextel Communications Inc and set a 12-month price target of $32 a share.
-- Said 1997 will be a "big" subscriber addition year for Nextel. Expects 643,000 net additions for 1997.
-- Nextel added 72,300 net new digital subscribers in the fourth quarter, topping many Wall Street estimates.
-- Nextel also announced its Nextel National Network, a nationwide digital wireless network that carries no roaming charges.
-- Nextel gained 1-3/16 to 14-15/16 and was one of the most active Nasdaq stocks.
